title: shred-audit — filter audit
description: Rotating gRPC filter audit: every source cycles through filter bundles in 30-60 s windows; each window is checked on every delivery (tags) and on sampled slots against the confirmed block (getBlock). Tables: filter_windows, filter_slot_checks, filter_violations, rpc_block_fetches.

target.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time,
       'collector ' || tool_version || ' @ ' || git_commit AS text,
       'restart' AS tags
FROM audit_runs
WHERE host = '$host' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

list.name: host
list.label: capture host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM filter_windows ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM filter_windows ORDER BY 1

list.name: source
list.label: source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM filter_windows WHERE host = '$host' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM filter_windows WHERE host = '$host' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Correctness — every value here should be 0 or near it
Filter false positives
panels.description: Delivered with a filter's tag, in the confirmed block, but the filter rejects it (filter_slot_checks.extra_in_block). A server-side filter bug. Must be 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(extra_in_block),0) AS value FROM filter_slot_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)

panels.title: Tag errors (self-check)
panels.description: Checked on EVERY delivery, not sampled: a tag on a transaction the filter rejects, or a matching transaction delivered without its tag (filter_windows.tag_false_positive + tag_missing). Must be 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tag_false_positive + tag_missing),0) AS value FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)

panels.title: Missed rate
panels.description: Block transactions a filter accepts that were not delivered with its tag, over all sampled slots in range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(missed)::float / NULLIF(SUM(expected),0) * 100 AS value FROM filter_slot_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)

panels.title: Slots checked
panels.description: Sampled slots compared against getBlock in range (all sources). Flat means the audit is not running — see RPC health.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (source, slot)) AS value FROM filter_slot_checks WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND block_status = 'ok'

panels.title: Missed rate per filter
panels.description: SUM(missed)/SUM(expected) per 5 minutes. A filter that runs intermittently (rotation) shows gaps between its windows — that is expected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5m'), source || ' / ' || filter AS metric,
       SUM(missed)::float / NULLIF(SUM(expected),0) * 100 AS value
FROM filter_slot_checks
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Filter false positives per filter
panels.description: extra_in_block per 5 minutes. Must be 0; anything here is a server filter bug — see the violations table for signatures and the failing clause.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5m'), source || ' / ' || filter AS metric, SUM(extra_in_block) AS value
FROM filter_slot_checks
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING SUM(extra_in_block) > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Not in the confirmed block (forks / phantoms)
panels.description: Delivered, but absent from the confirmed block (extra_not_in_block), as a share of deliveries. Pre-execution feeds carry some transactions from forks that lost, so a low steady rate is normal; a jump is not. Skipped slots count here too.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5m'), source AS metric,
       SUM(extra_not_in_block)::float / NULLIF(SUM(delivered),0) * 100 AS value
FROM filter_slot_checks
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Self-check per window
panels.description: Counted on every delivery of every window: tag false positives, missing tags, the server's is_vote disagreeing with the simple-vote rule, and repeat deliveries. Points are per window (at its end).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time, source || ' tag_fp' AS metric, tag_false_positive AS value FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND tag_false_positive > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ended_at, source || ' tag_missing', tag_missing FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND tag_missing > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ended_at, source || ' vote_flag', vote_flag_mismatch FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND vote_flag_mismatch > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ended_at, source || ' duplicates', duplicates FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND duplicates > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT ended_at, source || ' unknown/untagged', unknown_tags + untagged_updates FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND unknown_tags + untagged_updates > 0
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per filter over the range
panels.description: Everything the chain check measured, per (source, bundle, filter). Sort by missed % or extra_in_block.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source, bundle, filter,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE block_status = 'ok') AS slots,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE block_status = 'skipped') AS skipped,
       SUM(expected) AS expected, SUM(delivered) AS delivered, SUM(matched) AS matched,
       SUM(missed) AS missed,
       ROUND((SUM(missed)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(expected),0) * 100), 4) AS missed_pct,
       SUM(extra_in_block) AS extra_in_block,
       SUM(extra_not_in_block) AS extra_not_in_block
FROM filter_slot_checks
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY missed_pct DESC NULLS LAST, 1, 2, 3

panels.title: Violations — example transactions
panels.description: Up to 25 examples per (window, filter, kind); the counters elsewhere are exact. reason says which clause the filter used or failed, and whether a key came from a lookup table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts, source, bundle, filter, slot, violation, signature, reason
FROM filter_violations
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Recent windows
panels.description: One row per subscription window. end_reason other than 'rotated' is a stream or connect error.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at, source, bundle, ROUND(duration_secs::numeric, 1) AS secs, end_reason,
       delivered, slots_checked AS slots, slots_skipped AS skipped, slots_unchecked AS unchecked,
       expected, missed, extra_in_block, extra_not_in_block,
       tag_false_positive AS tag_fp, tag_missing, vote_flag_mismatch AS vote_flag,
       ROUND(connect_ms::numeric, 0) AS connect_ms, ROUND(first_msg_ms::numeric, 0) AS first_msg_ms,
       ROUND((vs_shred_p50_us / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS vs_shred_p50_ms
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Window errors
panels.description: Windows per 10 minutes that ended in an error instead of rotating.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '10m'), source AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND end_reason LIKE 'error%'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Connect and first message
panels.description: Per window: connect + subscribe, and time to the first message of any kind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time, source || ' connect' AS metric, connect_ms AS value FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND connect_ms IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT ended_at, source || ' first msg', first_msg_ms FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND first_msg_ms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: getBlock health
panels.description: Every getBlock the filter audit made, by status per 5 minutes. No 'ok' means no ground truth: nothing else on this dashboard is being checked.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '5m'), status AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM rpc_block_fetches
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: getBlock latency
panels.description: Per call, successful fetches only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, rpc AS metric, latency_ms AS value
FROM rpc_block_fetches
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host = '$host' AND status = 'ok'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Deliveries per second per window
panels.description: delivered / duration, per window and bundle — a filter that suddenly delivers far less (or nothing) shows here before it shows as misses.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ended_at AS time, source || ' / ' || bundle AS metric, delivered / NULLIF(duration_secs, 0) AS value
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency — per window, against the shred providers and the other sources
vs fastest shred provider — p50
panels.description: Per window: this feed's arrival minus the earliest shred provider's for the same transaction. Negative = the feed was ahead of every shred provider. Needs shred providers in the config.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '5m'), source AS metric, AVG(vs_shred_p50_us) / 1000 AS value
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND vs_shred_p50_us IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: vs fastest shred provider — p90
panels.description: Same as p50, 90th percentile per window, averaged per 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '5m'), source AS metric, AVG(vs_shred_p90_us) / 1000 AS value
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND vs_shred_p90_us IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Behind the earliest source — p50 / p90
panels.description: Per window, over transactions at least two sources delivered: how far behind the first arrival from ANY source.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '5m'), source || ' p50' AS metric, AVG(behind_p50_us) / 1000 AS value
FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND behind_p50_us IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '5m'), source || ' p90', AVG(behind_p90_us) / 1000
FROM filter_windows WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND behind_p90_us IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Winrate
panels.description: Share of contested transactions this feed delivered first, per 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '5m'), source AS metric, SUM(wins)::float / NULLIF(SUM(contested),0) * 100 AS value
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Server delay — receive minus created_at, p50
panels.description: Our receive time minus the server's created_at timestamp. Crosses two clocks, so it includes the skew between them: watch the trend, not the level.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ended_at, '5m'), source AS metric, AVG(server_delay_p50_us) / 1000 AS value
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source) AND server_delay_p50_us IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency by bundle over the range
panels.description: Does a filter make delivery slower? Averages of the per-window percentiles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source, bundle, COUNT(*) AS windows, SUM(delivered) AS delivered,
       ROUND((AVG(vs_shred_p50_us) / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS vs_shred_p50_ms,
       ROUND((AVG(vs_shred_p90_us) / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS vs_shred_p90_ms,
       ROUND((AVG(behind_p50_us) / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS behind_p50_ms,
       ROUND((SUM(wins)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(contested),0) * 100), 2) AS winrate_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(first_msg_ms)::numeric, 0) AS first_msg_ms
FROM filter_windows
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND host = '$host' AND source IN ($source)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
